title: Argumentli esse: band 7–8 namunalar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida aniq pozitsiyali, rivojlangan xatboshilardan iborat, leksik va grammatik jihatdan xilma-xil 250–300 so‘zli argumentli esse yoza olasiz va namunaviy javobni band 7–8 mezonlari bo‘yicha tahlil qila olasiz.

scenes.title: Band 7–8 sari
board: Lesson: The argumentative essay
(Argumentli esse: band 7–8 namunalar)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda kogeziyani o‘rgandik: havola, almashtirish va bog‘lovchilarni mexanik emas, mohirona ishlatish. Bugun hamma bilimlarni bitta matnda birlashtiramiz: argumentli esse. Dars oxirida aniq pozitsiyali, chuqur rivojlangan xatboshilarga ega esse yoza olasiz va namunaviy javoblarni band 7–8 mezonlari bo‘yicha tahlil qila olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time you learned to make a text hold together. Today we put everything into one demanding format: the argumentative essay that examiners would place at band seven or eight.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar matnni bir butun qilishni o‘rgandingiz. Bugun hammasini bitta talabchan formatga joylaymiz: imtihon oluvchilar yetti yoki sakkiz ball beradigan argumentli esse.

scenes.title: To‘rt mezon
board: Task Response · Coherence and Cohesion
Lexical Resource · Grammatical Range and Accuracy
Each = 25% · min. 250 words · about 40 minutes
scenes.say_native: IELTS Writing Task 2 esse to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha baholanadi va har biri bahoning to‘rtdan birini tashkil qiladi: topshiriqqa javob, izchillik va bog‘lanish, leksik boylik, grammatik xilma-xillik va aniqlik. Kamida 250 so‘z yozish kerak, tavsiya etilgan vaqt taxminan qirq daqiqa. Kogeziyani oldingi darsda ko‘rdik, bugun qolgan uchtasiga ko‘proq e’tibor beramiz.
scenes.say: Four criteria, each worth a quarter of the score: task response, coherence and cohesion, lexical resource, and grammatical range and accuracy. Write at least two hundred and fifty words in about forty minutes.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt mezon, har biri bahoning to‘rtdan biri: topshiriqqa javob, izchillik va bog‘lanish, leksik boylik, grammatik xilma-xillik va aniqlik. Taxminan qirq daqiqada kamida ikki yuz ellik so‘z yozing.

scenes.title: Savol turlari
board: To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
Problem → solution · two-part questions
scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: topshiriqqa javob va pozitsiya. Avval savol turini aniqlang, chunki har biri boshqacha javob talab qiladi. “To what extent do you agree” sizning qanchalik qo‘shilishingizni so‘raydi. “Discuss both views” ikkala qarashni muhokama qilib, o‘z fikringizni ham talab qiladi. “Do the advantages outweigh” esa solishtirib, qaysi tomon ustunligini aytishni so‘raydi.
scenes.say: To what extent do you agree or disagree? Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages? Each question type demands a different kind of answer.
scenes.say_uz: Qay darajada qo‘shilasiz yoki qo‘shilmaysiz? Ikkala qarashni muhokama qiling va o‘z fikringizni bildiring. Afzalliklar kamchiliklardan ustunmi? Har bir savol turi boshqacha javob talab qiladi.

scenes.title: Savolning barcha qismlari
board: Some people believe university education should be free for all.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Key words: university · free · for ALL
scenes.say_native: Mana bugungi savolimiz: ba’zilar universitet ta’limi hamma uchun bepul bo‘lishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Qay darajada qo‘shilasiz? Kalit so‘zlarni belgilang: university, ya’ni maktab emas; free; for all, ya’ni hamma uchun. “For all” juda muhim: siz “ba’zilar uchun bepul bo‘lsin” desangiz, bu qisman qo‘shilish va uni ochiq aytish kerak. Bitta qismni e’tiborsiz qoldirsangiz, Task Response bahosi tushadi.
scenes.say: Some people believe university education should be free for all. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Notice for all. Free for some students is a different claim, and your essay must deal with that difference.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zilar universitet ta’limi hamma uchun bepul bo‘lishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Qay darajada qo‘shilasiz? For all ga e’tibor bering. Ba’zi talabalar uchun bepul boshqa da’vo, va esse bu farq bilan ishlashi kerak.

scenes.title: Aniq va izchil pozitsiya
board: Thesis in the introduction
The same position in every paragraph
Restated in the conclusion
Partial agreement is fine — if it is clear

examples.t: While free tuition for all is appealing, I believe it should be limited to students from low-income families.
examples.uz: Hamma uchun bepul o‘qish jozibali bo‘lsa-da, menimcha, u kam ta’minlangan oilalar farzandlari bilan cheklanishi kerak.

scenes.say_native: Yuqori ball uchun pozitsiya butun esse davomida aniq bo‘lishi kerak. U kirishda tezis gapida aytiladi, har bir xatboshi uni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi va xulosada yana tasdiqlanadi. Qisman qo‘shilish ham mumkin, lekin u ham aniq bo‘lsin: “while … is appealing, I believe it should be limited to…”. O‘rtada fikrni o‘zgartirib qo‘yish eng xavfli xato.
scenes.say: While free tuition for all is appealing, I believe it should be limited to students from low-income families. That is a partial position, but it is completely clear.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma uchun bepul o‘qish jozibali bo‘lsa-da, menimcha, u kam ta’minlangan oilalar farzandlari bilan cheklanishi kerak. Bu qisman pozitsiya, lekin mutlaqo aniq.

scenes.title: Zaif va kuchli tezis
board: Weak: There are many advantages and disadvantages.
Weak: Education is very important nowadays.
Strong: I largely disagree, since free tuition would ...

examples.t: I largely disagree, since universal free tuition would place a heavy burden on taxpayers.
examples.uz: Men asosan qo‘shilmayman, chunki hamma uchun bepul o‘qish soliq to‘lovchilarga og‘ir yuk bo‘ladi.

scenes.say_native: Taqqoslang. “There are many advantages and disadvantages” hech qanday pozitsiya bermaydi. “Education is very important nowadays” umuman savolga javob emas. Kuchli tezis: “I largely disagree, since universal free tuition would place a heavy burden on taxpayers.” Unda daraja bor, largely; sabab bor, since; va savolning kalit so‘zlari bor.
scenes.say: I largely disagree, since universal free tuition would place a heavy burden on taxpayers. The thesis gives a degree, a reason and the key words of the question.
scenes.say_uz: Men asosan qo‘shilmayman, chunki hamma uchun bepul o‘qish soliq to‘lovchilarga og‘ir yuk bo‘ladi. Tezis daraja, sabab va savolning kalit so‘zlarini beradi.

scenes.title: Pozitsiyadagi xatolar
board: ✗ “In this modern world, education is a hot topic.”
✗ Agree in paragraph 2, disagree in the conclusion
✗ “Discuss both views” — but no opinion
✗ Writing about education in general
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi, yodlangan umumiy kirish: “In this modern world…”. Imtihon oluvchilar uni darhol taniydi va u hech narsa demaydi. Ikkinchisi, pozitsiyani yo‘l-yo‘lakay o‘zgartirish. Uchinchisi, “discuss both views” savolida o‘z fikrini bermaslik. To‘rtinchisi, mavzudan chetga chiqish: universitet o‘rniga umuman ta’lim haqida yozish.
scenes.say: Avoid memorised openings like in this modern world. Do not change your position halfway. Give your own opinion when the question asks for it. And answer the question that was set, not a similar one.
scenes.say_uz: In this modern world kabi yodlangan boshlanishlardan qoching. Pozitsiyani yarim yo‘lda o‘zgartirmang. Savol so‘rasa, o‘z fikringizni bering. Va o‘xshash savolga emas, berilgan savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Qaysi tezis yaxshiroq?
board: Q: Working from home does more harm than good. Agree?
A Working from home is popular nowadays.
B I partly agree: it harms teamwork, but benefits parents.
C There are both good and bad sides.
scenes.say_native: Savol: uydan ishlash foydadan ko‘ra ko‘proq zarar keltiradi. Qo‘shilasizmi? Uchta tezis variant bor: A, B, C. Qaysi biri savolga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri javob beradi va pozitsiyasi aniq? Qolgan ikkitasining muammosi nima? Pauza qiling va javobingizni asoslang.
scenes.say: Working from home does more harm than good. Do you agree? Which thesis is best: A, B or C? And what is wrong with the other two?
scenes.say_uz: Uydan ishlash foydadan ko‘ra ko‘proq zarar keltiradi. Qo‘shilasizmi? Qaysi tezis eng yaxshi: A, B yoki C? Qolgan ikkitasida nima xato?

scenes.title: Javob
board: B — clear partial position + two reasons
A — no position
C — vague, avoids the question
scenes.say_native: Javob: B. U qisman qo‘shiladi va sababini aniq aytadi: jamoaviy ishga zarar, lekin ota-onalarga foyda. Bu ikki sabab keyin ikkita asosiy xatboshi bo‘ladi. A faqat fakt aytadi, pozitsiya yo‘q. C esa noaniq va savoldan qochadi. Yaxshi tezis butun essening xaritasi bo‘lib xizmat qiladi.
scenes.say: B is best. It takes a clear partial position and previews two reasons, which become the two body paragraphs. A states a fact, and C avoids the question.
scenes.say_uz: B eng yaxshisi. U aniq qisman pozitsiya egallaydi va ikki sababni oldindan aytadi, ular ikki asosiy xatboshiga aylanadi. A fakt aytadi, C esa savoldan qochadi.

scenes.title: Kirish qismi
board: 1 Paraphrase the question
2 Thesis statement
(3 Optional outline)
2–3 sentences · about 40–50 words
scenes.say_native: Kirish qisqa bo‘lsin: ikki-uch gap, taxminan qirq-ellik so‘z. Birinchi gap savolni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta ifodalaydi. Ikkinchi gap tezis. Xohlasangiz, uchinchi gapda xatboshilar rejasini aytasiz. Kirishda dalil va misol bermang, ular asosiy qismga kerak. Uzun kirish vaqtni oladi, lekin ball qo‘shmaydi.
scenes.say: Keep the introduction short: paraphrase the question, state your thesis, and, if you like, outline the essay. Save your arguments and examples for the body.
scenes.say_uz: Kirishni qisqa qiling: savolni qayta ifodalang, tezisni ayting va xohlasangiz, esse rejasini bering. Dalil va misollarni asosiy qism uchun saqlang.

scenes.title: Savolni qayta ifodalash
board: free → without tuition fees / funded by the state
for all → for every student / universal
Some people believe → It is sometimes argued that

examples.t: It is sometimes argued that the state should cover tuition fees for every student.
examples.uz: Ba’zan davlat har bir talabaning o‘qish to‘lovini qoplashi kerak, deb ta’kidlanadi.

scenes.say_native: Qayta ifodalashda savoldan uzun bo‘laklarni ko‘chirmang, ko‘chirilgan so‘zlar hisobga olinmasligi mumkin. Ikki vosita bor: sinonim va tuzilmani o‘zgartirish. Free o‘rniga without tuition fees, for all o‘rniga for every student, some people believe o‘rniga it is sometimes argued that. Lekin ehtiyot bo‘ling: sinonim ma’noni o‘zgartirmasin.
scenes.say: It is sometimes argued that the state should cover tuition fees for every student. Same meaning, new words and a new structure. University stays university, though: some key terms have no safe synonym.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zan davlat har bir talabaning o‘qish to‘lovini qoplashi kerak, deb ta’kidlanadi. Ma’no bir xil, so‘zlar va tuzilma yangi. Lekin university university bo‘lib qoladi: ba’zi atamalarning xavfsiz sinonimi yo‘q.

scenes.title: Savolni qayta ifodalang
board: Many people think that governments should spend more money on public transport than on roads.
→ Paraphrase in one sentence
scenes.say_native: Doskadagi savolni bitta gapda qayta ifodalang: ko‘pchilik hukumatlar yo‘llardan ko‘ra jamoat transportiga ko‘proq pul sarflashi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Kamida ikkita sinonim ishlating va gap tuzilmasini o‘zgartiring. Lekin ma’no aynan saqlansin. Pauza qiling va yozing.
scenes.say: Paraphrase this question in one sentence. Many people think that governments should spend more money on public transport than on roads.
scenes.say_uz: Bu savolni bitta gapda qayta ifodalang. Ko‘pchilik hukumatlar yo‘llardan ko‘ra jamoat transportiga ko‘proq pul sarflashi kerak deb hisoblaydi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: It is widely argued that public transport, rather than road building, should be the priority for state funding.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “It is widely argued that public transport, rather than road building, should be the priority for state funding.” Many people think ga “it is widely argued that”, spend more money ga “should be the priority for state funding”, than on roads ga “rather than road building” aylandi. Public transport atamasi saqlandi, chunki uning yaxshi sinonimi yo‘q.
scenes.say: It is widely argued that public transport, rather than road building, should be the priority for state funding. The structure and most words have changed, but the meaning has not.
scenes.say_uz: Davlat mablag‘ida yo‘l qurilishi emas, jamoat transporti ustuvor bo‘lishi kerak, deb keng ta’kidlanadi. Tuzilma va ko‘p so‘zlar o‘zgardi, ma’no esa o‘zgarmadi.

scenes.title: Rivojlangan xatboshi tuzilishi
board: Topic sentence (main idea)
Explanation (why? how?)
Example (specific)
Link back to the thesis
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: rivojlangan xatboshi. Har bir asosiy xatboshi bitta g‘oyaga bag‘ishlanadi va to‘rt qismdan iborat. Asosiy gap g‘oyani aytadi. Tushuntirish nima uchun va qanday degan savollarga javob beradi. Misol g‘oyani aniq qiladi. Oxirgi gap uni tezisga bog‘laydi. Band 7 uchun g‘oyalar shunchaki aytilmasligi, balki kengaytirilib, qo‘llab-quvvatlanishi kerak.
scenes.say: A developed paragraph has four moves: a topic sentence with one main idea, an explanation of why or how, a specific example, and a final sentence linking back to your thesis.
scenes.say_uz: Rivojlangan xatboshida to‘rt qadam bor: bitta asosiy g‘oyali asosiy gap, nima uchun yoki qanday ekanini tushuntirish, aniq misol va tezisga qaytaruvchi yakuniy gap.

scenes.title: Namunaviy asosiy xatboshi
board: Topic: cost to taxpayers
Explain: money diverted from schools and hospitals
Example: a wealthy family's child · Link: targeted support is fairer
scenes.say_native: Mana to‘liq xatboshi. Diqqat bilan tinglang va to‘rt qismni ajrating. Asosiy gap soliq to‘lovchilar uchun xarajat haqida. Tushuntirish pul maktab va kasalxonalardan olinishini aytadi. Misol boy oila farzandi haqida. Va oxirgi gap tezisga qaytadi: maqsadli yordam adolatliroq.
scenes.say: The most compelling argument against universal free tuition is its cost to taxpayers. Funding every degree would inevitably divert money from schools and hospitals, which serve the whole population. Consider a student from a wealthy family: under such a system, a factory worker's taxes would pay for that student's education. Targeted grants for low-income students would therefore be a fairer use of public money.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma uchun bepul o‘qishga qarshi eng ishonchli dalil uning soliq to‘lovchilarga tushadigan xarajatidir. Har bir diplomni moliyalash muqarrar ravishda pulni butun aholiga xizmat qiluvchi maktab va kasalxonalardan olib qo‘yadi. Boy oiladan chiqqan talabani olaylik: bunday tizimda zavod ishchisining soliqlari o‘sha talabaning ta’limi uchun to‘lanadi. Shuning uchun kam ta’minlangan talabalar uchun maqsadli grantlar davlat pulidan adolatliroq foydalanish bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Kenglik emas, chuqurlik
board: 4 ideas listed ✗
2 ideas developed ✓
Ask: Why? So what? For whom?
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p talabalar har bir xatboshiga uch-to‘rtta g‘oya tiqadi va hech birini ochmaydi. Bu band 6 ning odatiy belgisi. Ikki g‘oyani chuqur rivojlantirish to‘rt g‘oyani sanab o‘tishdan yaxshiroq. G‘oyani kengaytirish uchun o‘zingizga uch savol bering: nima uchun? xo‘sh, nima bo‘pti? kim uchun? Har bir javob yangi gap bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Two ideas, fully developed, are better than four ideas listed. To extend an idea, ask yourself: why? So what? For whom? Each answer gives you another sentence of real content.
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq rivojlangan ikki g‘oya sanab o‘tilgan to‘rt g‘oyadan yaxshiroq. G‘oyani kengaytirish uchun o‘zingizdan so‘rang: nima uchun? Xo‘sh, nima bo‘pti? Kim uchun? Har bir javob haqiqiy mazmunli yana bir gap beradi.

scenes.title: Rivojlanmagan xatboshi va soxta raqamlar
board: ✗ Free education is good. It helps people. Also it is fair.
✗ Research shows that 87% of students ...
✓ For instance, a graduate who ... (plausible, not invented data)
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi, rivojlanmagan xatboshi: “Free education is good. It helps people. Also it is fair.” Uchta da’vo, birorta ham tushuntirish yo‘q. Ikkinchisi, to‘qib chiqarilgan statistika: “Research shows that 87 per cent…”. Imtihon oluvchi buni sezadi va bu ishonchni yo‘qotadi. Uning o‘rniga mantiqiy, real misol keltiring: “a graduate who…”.
scenes.say: Free education is good. It helps people. Also it is fair. Three claims, no development. And never invent statistics. A realistic example is far more convincing: for instance, a graduate who starts work without debt.
scenes.say_uz: Bepul ta’lim yaxshi. U odamlarga yordam beradi. Yana u adolatli. Uch da’vo, rivojlanish yo‘q. Va hech qachon statistika to‘qimang. Real misol ancha ishonarliroq: masalan, qarzsiz ish boshlagan bitiruvchi.

scenes.title: Xatboshini tartiblang
board: A This means that talented but poor students never apply.
B High tuition fees discourage many capable young people.
C Free tuition for them would therefore widen access.
D For example, a village student may fear a debt larger than her parents' income.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap aralashtirib berilgan. Ularni rivojlangan xatboshi tartibida joylashtiring: asosiy gap, tushuntirish, misol, tezisga bog‘lash. Har bir gapdagi qaysi so‘zlar sizga yordam berishini ham ayting, masalan this means, for example, therefore. Pauza qiling.
scenes.say: Put the sentences in the best order. A: This means that talented but poor students never apply. B: High tuition fees discourage many capable young people. C: Free tuition for them would therefore widen access. D: For example, a village student may fear a debt larger than her parents' income.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni eng yaxshi tartibda joylashtiring. A: bu iste’dodli, ammo kambag‘al talabalar hech qachon hujjat topshirmasligini anglatadi. B: yuqori to‘lovlar ko‘plab qobiliyatli yoshlarni qaytaradi. C: shuning uchun ular uchun bepul o‘qish imkoniyatni kengaytiradi. D: masalan, qishloqlik talaba ota-onasining daromadidan katta qarzdan qo‘rqishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Javob
board: B → A → D → C
topic → explanation → example → link
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: B, A, D, C. B asosiy g‘oyani aytadi. A “this means” bilan tushuntiradi, this oldingi gapga ishora qiladi. D “for example” bilan aniq misol beradi. C “therefore” bilan xulosa qilib, tezisga qaytaradi. E’tibor bering, bu xatboshi qisman qo‘shilish pozitsiyasini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi: bepul o‘qish hamma uchun emas, “for them”, ya’ni kambag‘allar uchun.
scenes.say: B, A, D, C. Topic sentence, explanation with this means, example with for example, and a link back with therefore.
scenes.say_uz: B, A, D, C. Asosiy gap, this means bilan tushuntirish, for example bilan misol va therefore bilan tezisga qaytish.

scenes.title: Qarshi dalil va raddiya
board: Critics argue that ...
However, this view overlooks ...
While it is true that ..., ...

examples.t: Critics argue that targeted grants create complex bureaucracy. However, this view overlooks the far greater cost of funding every student.
examples.uz: Tanqidchilar maqsadli grantlar murakkab byurokratiya yaratadi, deydi. Biroq bu qarash har bir talabani moliyalashning ancha katta xarajatini e’tiborsiz qoldiradi.

scenes.say_native: Yuqori darajali essening belgisi: qarshi fikrni tan olish va unga javob berish. Critics argue that… bilan qarshi fikrni adolatli bayon qiling, keyin “however, this view overlooks…” bilan raddiya bering. Bu sizning pozitsiyangizni zaiflashtirmaydi, aksincha, uni mustahkamlaydi. Faqat raddiya bo‘lishi shart, aks holda pozitsiyangiz noaniq bo‘lib qoladi.
scenes.say: Critics argue that targeted grants create complex bureaucracy. However, this view overlooks the far greater cost of funding every student. Present the opposing view fairly, then answer it.
scenes.say_uz: Tanqidchilar maqsadli grantlar murakkab byurokratiya yaratadi, deydi. Biroq bu qarash har bir talabani moliyalashning ancha katta xarajatini e’tiborsiz qoldiradi. Qarshi fikrni adolatli bayon qiling, keyin unga javob bering.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: Restate the position (new words)
Summarise the main reasons
No new ideas or examples

examples.t: In conclusion, although free tuition for all is an attractive ideal, support targeted at those in need is both fairer and more sustainable.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, hamma uchun bepul o‘qish jozibali g‘oya bo‘lsa-da, muhtojlarga qaratilgan yordam ham adolatliroq, ham barqarorroq.

scenes.say_native: Xulosa ikki-uch gapdan iborat. U pozitsiyani yangi so‘zlar bilan qayta tasdiqlaydi va asosiy sabablarni qisqacha eslatadi. Xulosada yangi g‘oya yoki misol bermang. Kirishdagi gapni so‘zma-so‘z takrorlamang ham. Xulosasiz esse, ayniqsa vaqt tugab qolganda, Task Response bahosini pasaytiradi, shuning uchun unga besh daqiqa qoldiring.
scenes.say: In conclusion, although free tuition for all is an attractive ideal, support targeted at those in need is both fairer and more sustainable. Restate, summarise, and stop.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, hamma uchun bepul o‘qish jozibali g‘oya bo‘lsa-da, muhtojlarga qaratilgan yordam ham adolatliroq, ham barqarorroq. Qayta tasdiqlang, xulosalang va to‘xtang.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ustoz fikri
board: Tutor: Mr Clarke
Student: Sardor
Essay: Should university be free for all?
scenes.say_native: Endi tinglang. Ustoz Klark talaba Sardorga essesi haqida fikr bildiryapti. U nimani maqtaydi, qaysi muammoni topadi va qanday maslahat beradi? Diqqat bilan tinglang, keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz. Sardorning xatosiga e’tibor bering, bu juda keng tarqalgan.
scenes.say: Clarke: Your vocabulary is impressive, Sardor. Sardor: Thank you. So is it a band eight? Clarke: Not yet. In your introduction you agree, but your conclusion says free education is unrealistic. Sardor: I changed my mind while writing. Clarke: That happens. Plan for five minutes first, so your position stays the same. Also, your second paragraph lists four ideas. Choose two and develop them.
scenes.say_uz: Klark: So‘z boyligingiz ta’sirli, Sardor. Sardor: Rahmat. Demak, band sakkizmi? Klark: Hali emas. Kirishda qo‘shilasiz, lekin xulosada bepul ta’lim real emas deysiz. Sardor: Yozayotib fikrimni o‘zgartirdim. Klark: Bu bo‘ladi. Avval besh daqiqa reja tuzing, shunda pozitsiyangiz o‘zgarmaydi. Yana, ikkinchi xatboshingiz to‘rtta g‘oyani sanab o‘tadi. Ikkitasini tanlang va rivojlantiring.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 1 What does Mr Clarke praise?
2 What is wrong with Sardor's position?
3 What two pieces of advice does he give?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi, ustoz Klark nimani maqtaydi? Ikkinchi, Sardorning pozitsiyasida qanday muammo bor? Uchinchi, ustoz qanday ikkita maslahat beradi? Inglizcha, to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni qayta tinglang. Shoshilmang.
scenes.say: One: What does Mr Clarke praise? Two: What is wrong with Sardor's position? Three: What two pieces of advice does he give?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Klark nimani maqtaydi? Ikki: Sardorning pozitsiyasida nima xato? Uch: u qanday ikki maslahat beradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 His vocabulary
2 It changes: agree → unrealistic
3 Plan for 5 minutes · develop two ideas, not four
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: so‘z boyligi. Ikkinchi: pozitsiya o‘zgaradi, kirishda qo‘shiladi, xulosada esa bepul ta’limni real emas deydi. Uchinchi: besh daqiqa reja tuzish va to‘rtta g‘oya o‘rniga ikkitasini rivojlantirish. Muhim saboq: kuchli so‘z boyligi zaif Task Response ni qutqarmaydi, chunki har bir mezon alohida baholanadi.
scenes.say: One: his vocabulary. Two: his position changes between the introduction and the conclusion. Three: plan for five minutes, and develop two ideas instead of listing four.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: so‘z boyligi. Ikki: pozitsiyasi kirish va xulosa o‘rtasida o‘zgaradi. Uch: besh daqiqa reja tuzing va to‘rtta g‘oyani sanash o‘rniga ikkitasini rivojlantiring.

scenes.title: Leksik boylik: aniqlik va kollokatsiya
board: tuition fees · student debt · social mobility
widen access to · bear the cost of
a heavy burden on · a sustainable model

examples.t: Free tuition could widen access to higher education and boost social mobility.
examples.uz: Bepul o‘qish oliy ta’limga kirish imkonini kengaytirib, ijtimoiy harakatchanlikni oshirishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: leksik va grammatik xilma-xillik. Leksik boylik noyob so‘zlar ro‘yxati emas. Imtihon oluvchi mavzuga oid aniq so‘zlarni va to‘g‘ri kollokatsiyalarni qidiradi: tuition fees, social mobility, widen access to, bear the cost of, a heavy burden on. Kamroq uchraydigan so‘zlar ham kerak, lekin ular aniq va o‘rinli ishlatilsa, ball beradi.
scenes.say: Free tuition could widen access to higher education and boost social mobility. Yet someone must bear the cost, and that places a heavy burden on taxpayers.
scenes.say_uz: Bepul o‘qish oliy ta’limga kirish imkonini kengaytirib, ijtimoiy harakatchanlikni oshirishi mumkin. Biroq kimdir xarajatni ko‘tarishi kerak va bu soliq to‘lovchilarga og‘ir yuk bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Takrorsiz yozish
board: students → undergraduates · young people · they
expensive → costly · places a strain on budgets
important → crucial · essential · a priority
scenes.say_native: Bir so‘zni o‘n marta takrorlash leksik bahoni pasaytiradi. Uch usul bor: sinonim, masalan students o‘rniga undergraduates; havola, ya’ni they, this group; va boshqa so‘z turkumi, expensive o‘rniga “places a strain on budgets”. Lekin sinonimlar har doim ham to‘liq teng emas: important va crucial darajasi farq qiladi, ularni kontekstga qarab tanlang.
scenes.say: Instead of repeating students, try undergraduates, young people or simply they. Instead of expensive, say costly, or that it places a strain on public budgets.
scenes.say_uz: Students ni takrorlash o‘rniga undergraduates, young people yoki shunchaki they deng. Expensive o‘rniga costly deng yoki davlat byudjetiga yuk tushiradi deng.

scenes.title: Leksik xatolar
board: ✗ The cost of education is very expensive. → ✓ ... is very high.
✗ make a crime → ✓ commit a crime
✗ knowledges, peoples (= people) → ✓ knowledge, people
✗ It's a piece of cake for the government.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta tipik xato. “The cost is expensive” mantiqan noto‘g‘ri: narsa qimmat bo‘ladi, narx esa yuqori, the cost is high. “Make a crime” emas, “commit a crime”. Knowledge sanalmaydi, knowledges demang; peoples esa “xalqlar” degani, odamlar emas. To‘rtinchisi: “a piece of cake” kabi so‘zlashuv iboralari essega mos emas, ular ball qo‘shmaydi.
scenes.say: The cost of education is very high, not very expensive. People commit crimes, they don't make them. Knowledge has no plural. And idioms like a piece of cake belong in conversation, not in an essay.
scenes.say_uz: Ta’lim narxi juda yuqori, juda qimmat emas. Odamlar jinoyat sodir etadi, make emas. Knowledge ning ko‘pligi yo‘q. A piece of cake kabi iboralar essega emas, suhbatga tegishli.

scenes.title: Grammatik xilma-xillik
board: conditionals · relative clauses · passive
Not only ... but also (inversion)
participle clauses · cleft: What matters is ...
Range + accuracy (many error-free sentences)

examples.t: Were tuition free for all, universities would struggle to maintain quality.
examples.uz: Agar o‘qish hamma uchun bepul bo‘lsa, universitetlar sifatni saqlashga qiynalardi.

examples.t: What matters most is not the price but access.
examples.uz: Eng muhimi narx emas, balki imkoniyat.

scenes.say_native: Grammatik xilma-xillik uchun murakkab tuzilmalar aralashmasi kerak: shart gaplar, nisbiy gaplar, majhul nisbat, inversiya, sifatdosh oborotlari va “what matters is” kabi ajratuvchi tuzilmalar. Lekin band 7 uchun faqat xilma-xillik emas, aniqlik ham muhim: ko‘p gaplar xatosiz bo‘lishi kerak. Ishonchingiz komil bo‘lmagan tuzilmani majburan ishlatmang.
scenes.say: Were tuition free for all, universities would struggle to maintain quality. What matters most is not the price but access. Having graduated without debt, young people can take more risks.
scenes.say_uz: Agar o‘qish hamma uchun bepul bo‘lsa, universitetlar sifatni saqlashga qiynalardi. Eng muhimi narx emas, balki imkoniyat. Qarzsiz bitirgan yoshlar ko‘proq tavakkal qila oladi.

scenes.title: Oddiy gapni boyitish
board: Simple: University is expensive. Poor students don't go.
Upgraded: Faced with high fees, many students from poorer backgrounds decide against applying, which wastes considerable talent.
scenes.say_native: Oddiy gaplarni qanday boyitish mumkin? “University is expensive. Poor students don’t go.” Ikki sodda gap. Boyitilgani: “Faced with high fees, many students from poorer backgrounds decide against applying, which wastes considerable talent.” Bitta gapda sifatdosh oboroti, aniq kollokatsiya, decide against, va butun gapga ishora qiluvchi which bor. Ma’no esa o‘sha-o‘sha.
scenes.say: University is expensive. Poor students don't go. Now: Faced with high fees, many students from poorer backgrounds decide against applying, which wastes considerable talent.
scenes.say_uz: Universitet qimmat. Kambag‘al talabalar bormaydi. Endi: yuqori to‘lovlarga duch kelgan kam ta’minlangan oilalardan chiqqan ko‘plab talabalar hujjat topshirmaslikka qaror qiladi, bu esa katta iste’dodni behuda ketkazadi.

scenes.title: Artikl va kelishuv xatolari
board: ✗ Government should pay. → ✓ The government / Governments should pay.
✗ Education are important. → ✓ Education is ...
✗ the most of students → ✓ most students
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida so‘zlovchilarda uchraydigan grammatik xatolar. “Government should pay” da artikl yo‘q: the government yoki ko‘plikda governments. Education sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun is. “The most of students” emas, “most students” yoki “most of the students”. Bu kichik xatolar ko‘p takrorlansa, Grammatical Accuracy bahosini tushiradi, shuning uchun oxirgi besh daqiqada aynan ularni tekshiring.
scenes.say: The government should pay, or governments should pay. Education is important. Most students, or most of the students, but never the most of students.
scenes.say_uz: Hukumat to‘lashi kerak: the government yoki governments. Ta’lim muhim: is. Most students yoki most of the students, lekin hech qachon the most of students emas.

scenes.title: Gaplarni boyiting
board: 1 Online courses are cheap. Many people use them.
2 If university is free, it gets crowded.
3 The price is the main problem. (use: What ...)
scenes.say_native: Uchta sodda gapni boyiting. Birinchisini nisbiy gap yoki sifatdosh oboroti bilan bitta gapga birlashtiring. Ikkinchisini ikkinchi shart yoki inversiya bilan qayta yozing. Uchinchisini “What” bilan boshlanadigan ajratuvchi gapga aylantiring. Aniqlikni saqlang. Pauza qiling.
scenes.say: Upgrade these sentences. One: Online courses are cheap. Many people use them. Two: If university is free, it gets crowded. Three: The price is the main problem. Start with what.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gaplarni boyiting. Bir: onlayn kurslar arzon. Ko‘p odamlar ulardan foydalanadi. Ikki: universitet bepul bo‘lsa, gavjum bo‘lib ketadi. Uch: narx asosiy muammo. What bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1 Online courses, which are relatively cheap, attract large numbers of learners.
2 Were university free, lecture halls would become overcrowded.
3 What is really holding students back is the price.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchi: “Online courses, which are relatively cheap, attract large numbers of learners.” Nisbiy gap va aniqroq fe’l, attract. Ikkinchi: “Were university free, lecture halls would become overcrowded.” Inversiya va ikkinchi shart. Uchinchi: “What is really holding students back is the price.” Ajratuvchi gap urg‘uni narxga qaratadi. Sizning variantlaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say: One: Online courses, which are relatively cheap, attract large numbers of learners. Two: Were university free, lecture halls would become overcrowded. Three: What is really holding students back is the price.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: nisbatan arzon bo‘lgan onlayn kurslar ko‘plab o‘quvchilarni jalb qiladi. Ikki: universitet bepul bo‘lganida, ma’ruza zallari odamga to‘lib ketardi. Uch: talabalarni aslida to‘xtatib turgan narsa narxdir.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javobni qanday tahlil qilish
board: 1 Find the thesis — is it kept?
2 Map each paragraph: topic → explain → example → link
3 Highlight collocations and complex structures
4 Compare with your own essay
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: namunaviy javobni tahlil qilish. Namunani shunchaki o‘qish yetarli emas, uni qismlarga ajrating. Birinchi, tezisni toping va u oxirigacha saqlanganini tekshiring. Ikkinchi, har bir xatboshi qanday qurilganini belgilang. Uchinchi, kollokatsiyalar va murakkab tuzilmalarni rang bilan ajrating. To‘rtinchi, o‘z essengiz bilan solishtirib, nimani o‘zlashtirish mumkinligini yozing.
scenes.say: Do not just read model answers; take them apart. Find the thesis and check it is kept. Map each paragraph. Highlight collocations and complex structures. Then compare them with your own work.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javoblarni shunchaki o‘qimang, ularni qismlarga ajrating. Tezisni toping va saqlanganini tekshiring. Har bir xatboshini tahlil qiling. Kollokatsiya va murakkab tuzilmalarni belgilang. Keyin o‘z ishingiz bilan solishtiring.

scenes.title: Band 6 va band 8 xatboshisi
board: Band 6: Free university is good because more people can study and it is fair. Also the country develops.
Band 8: Removing fees would allow talented students from any background to enrol, thereby strengthening the national economy.
scenes.say_native: Bir g‘oyaning ikki versiyasini solishtiring. Band 6 versiyasida uchta g‘oya bor, lekin birortasi rivojlanmagan, “good” va “also” kabi oddiy so‘zlar. Band 8 versiyasida bitta g‘oya izchil rivojlangan: to‘lovlarni olib tashlash, iste’dodli talabalar, iqtisodiyotga ta’sir. Aniq so‘zlar, enrol, from any background, va thereby bilan sabab-oqibat. Farq so‘z sonida emas, chuqurlikda.
scenes.say: Band six: Free university is good because more people can study and it is fair. Also the country develops. Band eight: Removing fees would allow talented students from any background to enrol, thereby strengthening the national economy.
scenes.say_uz: Band olti: bepul universitet yaxshi, chunki ko‘proq odam o‘qiy oladi va bu adolatli. Yana mamlakat rivojlanadi. Band sakkiz: to‘lovlarni bekor qilish istalgan qatlamdan chiqqan iste’dodli talabalarga o‘qishga kirish imkonini berib, milliy iqtisodiyotni mustahkamlaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: namunani tahlil qilish
board: Students: Nilufar and Tom
Task: analyse a band 8 model essay
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Talabalar Nilufar va Tom band 8 namunaviy esseni tahlil qilmoqda. Ular namunada qanday xususiyatlarni topishini va Nilufar o‘z essesi uchun qanday xulosa chiqarishini tinglang. Ular topgan narsalarni bugungi to‘rt nuqta bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Tom: The thesis is in the second sentence, and the conclusion repeats it in different words. Nilufar: Each body paragraph has only one idea, but look how long the explanation is. Tom: And only one example, a very specific one. Nilufar: The vocabulary isn't rare, really. It's just precise: bear the cost, widen access. Tom: So what will you change? Nilufar: Fewer ideas, deeper explanations, and I'll stop forcing idioms.
scenes.say_uz: Tom: Tezis ikkinchi gapda, xulosa esa uni boshqa so‘zlar bilan takrorlaydi. Nilufar: Har bir asosiy xatboshida faqat bitta g‘oya bor, lekin tushuntirish qanchalik uzunligiga qara. Tom: Va faqat bitta misol, juda aniq misol. Nilufar: So‘zlar unchalik noyob emas aslida. Ular shunchaki aniq: bear the cost, widen access. Tom: Xo‘sh, sen nimani o‘zgartirasan? Nilufar: Kamroq g‘oya, chuqurroq tushuntirish va iboralarni majburan tiqishni to‘xtataman.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 1 Where is the thesis in the model?
2 What do they notice about the vocabulary?
3 Name Nilufar's three changes.
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi, namunada tezis qayerda joylashgan? Ikkinchi, ular so‘z boyligi haqida nimani payqashadi? Uchinchi, Nilufar o‘z essesida qaysi uchta narsani o‘zgartirmoqchi? Inglizcha, to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Kerak bo‘lsa, qayta tinglang.
scenes.say: One: Where is the thesis in the model? Two: What do they notice about the vocabulary? Three: Name Nilufar's three changes.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: namunada tezis qayerda? Ikki: ular so‘z boyligi haqida nimani payqashadi? Uch: Nilufarning uchta o‘zgarishini ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 In the second sentence of the introduction
2 Not rare, but precise
3 Fewer ideas · deeper explanations · no forced idioms
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: tezis kirishning ikkinchi gapida. Ikkinchi: so‘zlar noyob emas, lekin aniq: bear the cost, widen access. Uchinchi: kamroq g‘oya, chuqurroq tushuntirish va iboralarni majburan ishlatmaslik. Bu dialog bugungi darsning qisqacha mazmuni: yuqori ball murakkablikdan emas, aniqlik va chuqurlikdan keladi.
scenes.say: One: in the second sentence of the introduction. Two: the vocabulary is not rare, but precise. Three: fewer ideas, deeper explanations, and no forced idioms.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: kirishning ikkinchi gapida. Ikki: so‘zlar noyob emas, lekin aniq. Uch: kamroq g‘oya, chuqurroq tushuntirish va majburiy iboralarsiz.

scenes.title: Qirq daqiqa rejasi
board: 5 min: analyse the question + plan
30 min: write (intro · 2 body · conclusion)
5 min: check articles, agreement, spelling
scenes.say_native: Vaqtni taqsimlash. Besh daqiqa: savolni tahlil qilish, pozitsiyani tanlash va har bir xatboshi uchun bitta g‘oya va bitta misol yozib olish. O‘ttiz daqiqa: yozish, kirish, ikkita yoki uchta asosiy xatboshi va xulosa. Besh daqiqa: tekshirish, ayniqsa artikllar, fe’l kelishuvi va imlo. Reja tuzish vaqtni yo‘qotish emas, u Sardorning xatosidan saqlaydi.
scenes.say: Spend five minutes planning, thirty minutes writing and five minutes checking. Planning is not wasted time: it is what keeps your position consistent from start to finish.
scenes.say_uz: Besh daqiqa reja tuzing, o‘ttiz daqiqa yozing va besh daqiqa tekshiring. Reja tuzish vaqtni yo‘qotish emas: u pozitsiyangizni boshidan oxirigacha izchil saqlaydi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy yozma vazifa
board: Some people think that all young people should do a year of community service. To what extent do you agree?
Write: introduction + one developed body paragraph
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Savol: ba’zilar barcha yoshlar bir yil jamoat ishida xizmat qilishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Qay darajada qo‘shilasiz? Kirish va bitta rivojlangan asosiy xatboshi yozing. Kirishda savolni qayta ifodalang va tezis bering. Xatboshida asosiy gap, tushuntirish, misol va bog‘lash bo‘lsin. Pauza qiling, kerak bo‘lsa to‘xtatib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Final task. Some people think that all young people should do a year of community service. To what extent do you agree? Write an introduction and one fully developed body paragraph.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Ba’zilar barcha yoshlar bir yil jamoat ishida xizmat qilishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Qay darajada qo‘shilasiz? Kirish va bitta to‘liq rivojlangan asosiy xatboshi yozing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Intro: It is sometimes suggested that ... I partly agree: ... voluntary, not compulsory.
Body: topic → explanation → example → link
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang. Kirishda savol qayta ifodalangan va qisman qo‘shilish pozitsiyasi aniq: xizmat foydali, lekin majburiy emas, ixtiyoriy bo‘lishi kerak. Asosiy xatboshida to‘rtta qism bor va misol aniq. O‘z javobingizni tekshiring: tezisingiz aniqmi, xatboshida bitta g‘oya rivojlanganmi, misol realmi?
scenes.say: It is sometimes suggested that every young person should spend a year serving their community. I partly agree: such service is valuable, but it should be voluntary rather than compulsory. Volunteering can give young people skills that classrooms rarely teach. A teenager who helps at a care home, for instance, learns patience and responsibility. Making this compulsory, however, would turn a generous act into an obligation.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zan har bir yosh bir yilni jamiyatiga xizmat qilib o‘tkazishi kerak, deb taklif qilinadi. Men qisman qo‘shilaman: bunday xizmat qimmatli, lekin u majburiy emas, ixtiyoriy bo‘lishi kerak. Ko‘ngillilik yoshlarga sinfxonada kamdan-kam o‘rgatiladigan ko‘nikmalarni beradi. Masalan, qariyalar uyida yordam beradigan o‘smir sabr va mas’uliyatni o‘rganadi. Biroq buni majburiy qilish saxovatli ishni majburiyatga aylantiradi.

scenes.title: Darsning xulosasi
board: Task response: answer every part, one clear position
Paragraphs: topic → explain → example → link
Range: precise collocations + accurate complex grammar
Models: take them apart, then compare
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: savol turini aniqlang, barcha qismlariga javob bering va bitta aniq pozitsiyani oxirigacha saqlang. Ikkinchi: har bir xatboshida bitta g‘oya, tushuntirish, aniq misol va tezisga bog‘lash. Uchinchi: noyob emas, aniq so‘zlar va xatosiz murakkab grammatika. To‘rtinchi: namunaviy javoblarni qismlarga ajratib tahlil qiling va o‘z ishingiz bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: To sum up: answer the question you are given with one clear position, develop fewer ideas in more depth, choose precise words and accurate structures, and learn from model answers by taking them apart.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: berilgan savolga bitta aniq pozitsiya bilan javob bering, kamroq g‘oyani chuqurroq rivojlantiring, aniq so‘z va to‘g‘ri tuzilmalarni tanlang, namunaviy javoblardan ularni qismlarga ajratib o‘rganing.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: a 280-word argumentative essay
Success: clear thesis kept · 2 developed paragraphs · counterargument + rebuttal · checked for articles
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: taxminan 280 so‘zli argumentli esse yozing. Mavzu: universitet ta’limi hamma uchun bepul bo‘lishi kerakmi yoki yoshlar bir yil jamoat ishida xizmat qilishi kerakmi. Mezon: aniq tezis oxirigacha saqlansin, ikkita rivojlangan asosiy xatboshi, bitta qarshi dalil va raddiya bo‘lsin, oxirida artikl va kelishuvni tekshiring. Keyingi darsda murakkab matnlarda muallif niyatini aniqlashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: write an argumentative essay of about two hundred and eighty words on one of today's questions. Keep one clear thesis, develop two body paragraphs, and include a counterargument with a rebuttal.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: bugungi savollardan biri bo‘yicha taxminan ikki yuz sakson so‘zli argumentli esse yozing. Bitta aniq tezisni saqlang, ikkita asosiy xatboshini rivojlantiring va raddiyasi bilan qarshi dalil qo‘shing.

homework_uz: Taxminan 280 so‘zli argumentli esse yozing. Mavzu: “Some people believe university education should be free for all” yoki “All young people should do a year of community service” — qay darajada qo‘shilasiz? Mezon: kirishda aniq tezis va u xulosagacha o‘zgarmasin; ikkita rivojlangan asosiy xatboshi (asosiy gap → tushuntirish → aniq misol → tezisga bog‘lash); bitta qarshi dalil va raddiya; to‘qib chiqarilgan statistika yo‘q; oxirida artikl, fe’l kelishuvi va imloni tekshiring.

quiz.q: How many criteria are used to assess an IELTS Task 2 essay?
quiz.why_uz: Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy — har biri 25%.

quiz.q: Which is the strongest thesis statement?
options: There are many advantages and disadvantages.
I largely disagree, since universal free tuition would burden taxpayers.
In this modern world, education is a hot topic.
quiz.why_uz: Kuchli tezis darajani, sababni va savolning kalit so‘zlarini beradi.

quiz.q: A “Discuss both views and give your opinion” essay with no opinion will mainly lose marks in...
quiz.why_uz: Savolning bir qismiga javob berilmagan — bu Task Response.

quiz.q: What is the best order for a developed body paragraph?
quiz.why_uz: Asosiy gap, tushuntirish, misol, tezisga bog‘lash.

quiz.q: Which is better for a band 7–8 essay?
options: Four ideas listed in one paragraph
The cost of education is very expensive.
The cost of education is very high.
The cost of education is very dear.
The education cost is very expensively.
quiz.why_uz: Narx yuqori (high) bo‘ladi, qimmat (expensive) narsa bo‘ladi.

quiz.q: Choose the correct collocation: to ___ the cost.
___ tuition free for all, universities would struggle.
quiz.why_uz: Inversiyali shart: Were tuition free = If tuition were free.
Most students yoki most of the students; the most of students noto‘g‘ri.

quiz.q: What should the conclusion NOT contain?
options: A summary of the main reasons
A new argument with a new example
quiz.why_uz: Xulosada yangi g‘oya va misol berilmaydi.
